extracted.intended_audience: authors preparing LaTeX manuscripts for Journal of Fluid Mechanics (JFM) / LaTeX users formatting JFM submissions
extracted.subtask_description: Formatting and macro-level requirements for preparing manuscripts using the jfm LaTeX class for submission to Journal of Fluid Mechanics, including title page, sectioning, floats, equation/theorem environments, bibliography and other presentation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright / permitted use
rubrics_metrics.description: This software may only be used in the preparation of journal articles or books or parts of books to be published by Cambridge University Press. Any other use constitutes an infringement of copyright.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should only use the jfm.cls for manuscripts intended for Cambridge University Press / Journal of Fluid Mechanics publication; other use is prohibited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available document-class options
rubrics_metrics.description: Declareable options include: oneside, twoside, draft, final, onecolumn, twocolumn, titlepage, notitlepage, leqno, fleqn, index, prodtf, referee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExecuteOptions default to twoside, final, onecolumn. Use \DeclareOption to select behavior (e.g., \DeclareOption{referee}{\@refereetrue}).

rubrics_metrics.name: Default class execution options
rubrics_metrics.description: ExecuteOptions{twoside,final,onecolumn}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unless overridden, the class will format documents two-sided, in final mode, and single-column; authors should set options explicitly if different behavior is desired (e.g., referee or draft).

rubrics_metrics.name: Page layout and geometry defaults
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets margins, topmargin, headheight, headsep, topskip, textheight, textwidth, columnsep, footskip and related lengths (e.g., \textheight=49\baselineskip, \textwidth=32pc, \columnsep=10\p@).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should rely on the class for correct page geometry; do not override unless necessary for an approved reason.

rubrics_metrics.name: Font sizes and font commands
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines \normalsize and sizes for \small, \footnotesize, \scriptsize, \tiny, \large through \Huge and defines font-switching commands (e.g., \qsmall, \qsmit, \qsbf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard LaTeX size commands; class ensures consistent typography. Specialized font macros are provided for internal use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title, author, affiliation and maketitle behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Macros: \title, \shorttitle, \author, \shortauthor, \affiliation; \maketitle creates a title page showing title, authors (lowercased by default), affiliation and '(Received \@date)' and then disables \@maketitle and \maketitle to prevent reuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide title, author and affiliation via the provided macros. \maketitle will produce the formatted title page and clear title/author macros afterwards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Under-journal / submission header and DOI macro
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines \@underjournal and \@journal text: by default shows 'Under consideration for publication in J. Fluid Mech.' and a preprint prepared message; \doi{#1} sets \@doi to 10.1017/#1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Class supplies the standard header for submitted manuscripts; authors should use \doi if a DOI is to be included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides an abstract environment: \begin{abstract} ... \end{abstract} formatted with normalfont and no indentation, followed by a vertical skip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the manuscript abstract within the provided abstract environment; formatting (no indent, spacing) is handled by the class.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords environment and heading
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides a keywords environment that prints 'Key words:' bolded and then the text; ends with a horizontal rule: \vbox{\centerline{\rule[4\p@]{30pc}{.4\p@}}}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply key words inside \begin{keywords} ... \end{keywords}; class enforces the 'Key words:' label and a separator rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sectioning and numbering style
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines \section, \subsection, \subsubsection formatting, custom \@seccntformat and \@secappcntformat, and sets \setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}. Sections reset equation counters unless \nosectioneqnreset is set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard \section etc.; numbering depth includes subsubsections. Equations are normally numbered per section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equation numbering by section and subequation support
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets \renewcommand\theequation{\thesection.\@arabic\c@equation} and provides CUPsubequations, subeqnarray, and subeqnarray* environments to produce lettered subequations (a, b, ...).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equations are numbered as section.number; use provided subequations/subeqnarray environments for grouped, lettered equation numbering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theorem/proof and remark environments
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides \@xnthm/\@ynthm/\@othm machinery to declare theorems; defines proof and proof* environments (with 'Proof.' in italic) and optional framed proof box at the end. Also provides \newremark to create remark-like environments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare theorems and remarks with the provided macros; the proof environment appends a framed proof box (or raised box if configured).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof-end box behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: A proof-end box is defined (\newsavebox{\proofbox}) and proof environment appends the box at the end unless \raiseproofboxby is used to shift it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proof environment automatically places a proof-end symbol; authors need not add a QED symbol manually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Floats: figure and table environments and caption style
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines figure/figure* and table/table* environments with caption styling via \@makecaption which centers small scshape labels and text and can draw horizontal rules for bottom figures; tables include rules drawn (\rule{\textwidth}{.5\p@}) before/after content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard float environments; captions are formatted by the class (small, scshape label, centered unless wide). Tables are separated by rules as per class style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Float placement and fraction parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets \setcounter{topnumber}{3}, \topfraction{.9}, \setcounter{bottomnumber}{0}, \bottomfraction{.9}, \setcounter{totalnumber}{3}, \textfraction{.05}, \floatpagefraction{.9}, \setcounter{dbltopnumber}{3}, \dbltopfraction{.9}, \dblfloatpagefraction{.5}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Class allows many floats at top with high fractions; authors should trust these defaults for float placement. Avoid forcing nonstandard float placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography formatting and heading
rubrics_metrics.description: Redefines thebibliography environment to center a small-caps 'REFERENCES' heading and to format entries with no numeric labels (labelwidth 0, leftmargin 2em, itemindent -2em). Also provides compatibility with natbib: AtBeginDocument sets \bibpunct and maps \thebibliography to JFMthebib.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a standard \begin{thebibliography} ... \end{thebibliography} or use natbib; the class enforces the 'REFERENCES' heading and entry layout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation command behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides a robust \cite command that supports optional arguments; if natbib is loaded, the class sets natbib punctuation to ( ), ; and adapts bibliography macros accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use \cite as normal; if using natbib the class adjusts punctuation and bibliography macros to JFM style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lists and description environment formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Customizes itemize/enumerate label tokens (\labelitemi bullet, \labelitemii circled, etc.), sets list spacing defaults (\@listI etc.), and provides a description environment whose label uses bold font; if index option used, description spacing changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard list environments; class enforces compact list spacing and particular label styles for JFM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote and symbol ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines \@fnsymbol and \thefootnote to use symbol-style footnote markers (dagger, double dagger, pilcrow-like) and provides \fulloutfootnote to toggle full footnote printing on title page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes on title page are controlled; the class uses symbol footnote markers by default for certain contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix formatting and numbering
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines \appendix and \oneappendix which reset section and equation counters and change \thesection to letters; sets \theequation to include section letter prefix with equation number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided \appendix command to begin appendices; it ensures equations and sections are lettered and numbered consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgments environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides an acknowledgments environment that inserts vertical space and normal paragraph formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use \begin{acknowledgments} ... \end{acknowledgments} for acknowledgments; alias \acknowledgements is also defined.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of contents and ToC entry formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines \contentsname as 'CONTENTS', custom \tableofcontents formatting and \l@section/\l@subsection/\l@subsubsection entries with bold section titles and page number spacing via dotted lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a table of contents is used (rare for JFM articles), the class provides the required formatting and spacing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index environment and index mode option
rubrics_metrics.description: If class option 'index' is provided, special index title sizes, journal header text and title page formatting are activated (\indextitlesize, modified \@maketitle, altered \@journal display).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors requesting an index should enable the index option; the class will then use alternate title and journal header formats suitable for indexing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Macro and counter hygiene after title generation
rubrics_metrics.description: \maketitle clears \@maketitle, \@thanks, \@title, \@author, \@affiliation and redefines \maketitle and \thanks to \relax so they cannot be reused.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once \maketitle is called, internal title macros are cleared to avoid duplication; authors should set all title metadata before calling \maketitle.
